rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Kali Linux Tools exposes 13 penetration testing utilities including nmap, gobuster, nikto, sqlmap, hydra, john, wpscan, and enum4linux through a unified interface. Supports stdio, SSE, and streamable HTTP transports. An optional remote code execution capability is available for controlled environments but disabled by default.
